head: Pitch Mode presents slides from your iPhone with notes and a timer
dek: Pitch Mode shows your slides on a TV or monitor while your iPhone or iPad keeps speaker notes, the next slide and a timer. It was #48 among paid Business apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: On the iPhone Duo, the presenter view splits across the inner screen. It costs $7.99 with no in-app purchases, by Chris Arrow, and needs iOS 27.
means: You can give a presentation without a laptop.
todo: Find Pitch Mode in the App Store.
